proves.claim: pullboard clock runs one clock pass for the coordinator, prints the due item's id, rule and move, and a seat is refused COORDINATOR_ONLY.

cli.io-commands-clock.one-pass.why: Without it the clock command could run for a seat or print nothing of what the pass did, and the board would change unseen.

proves.claim: pullboard clock --dry-run --json prints clockSweep's versioned document and writes no event.

cli.io-commands-clock.dry-run-json.why: Without it a dry run could write clock_move events or print a document other tools cannot parse.
